approval_reference: 2026-10-14 user requested the full experiment rerun and confirmed the original E0b D/R/T, 84-day history and E2 household permission rules; new E0b run independently verified before E1 input preparation
test_transaction_policy: for each T campaign use transaction rows in its own START_DAY-84 <= DAY < START_DAY window; never use T redemption labels

group_policy.frequency: D empirical nearest-rank 1/3 and 2/3 thresholds; boundary goes to lower group; repeated thresholds merge empty groups
group_policy.historical_redemption: D median among rows with at least one permitted prior completed campaign; boundary goes to low; zero prior campaigns is no_history
group_policy.target_category_match: D empirical nearest-rank 1/3 and 2/3 thresholds; boundary goes to lower group; repeated thresholds merge empty groups

persona_policy: deterministic rendering of observed household and campaign facts only; no identifiers, demographics, psychology, motives, outcome, coupon value, creative, image, or minimum-spend invention
